### African American Politics
**Northwestern University** · Winter, 2023


As an educator of social science, I view the classroom as an opportunity to help students pragmatically and theoretically engage with systems of power, by developing essential analytical skills to critically assess the world around them. In pursuit of these goals, my teaching philosophy centers on: 1. developing accessible courses  2. cultivating meaningful, critical engagement 3. empowering students. My own scholarly focus on identity and migration has helped me cultivate the necessary skills to create an inclusive classroom where students can comfortably engage with the complexities of politics.

- Immigration Politics
